findings.issue: The new Main-results bullet for `commute_transvection` / `commutatorElement_transvection` is placed directly above the unqualified note `Ported from the AINTLIB LeanModularForms project ([LeanModularForms/HeckeRIngs/GLn/SLnTransvection.lean], Chris Birkbeck)`, so a reader takes the new commutator relations to be part of that port. They are not: they come from the Tau Ceti GLₙ transvection file and from this PR.

summary: The new SLₙ Chevalley file credits its formal source (the GLₙ ChevalleyRelations development) and its informal sources correctly. But the PR adds ~70 lines of new, non-AINTLIB material to a file whose copyright header credits Chris Birkbeck alone and whose module doc declares the file a port of Birkbeck's AINTLIB code, so the new theorems are credited to a source they did not come from.
